crop.notes: Clipping is a run of Belleville local briefs (the BELLEVILLE column heading is just above the crop); only the quoits-game paragraph mentions Allen.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, ex-pugilist, attended a $100 quoits match at Sam Swancut's in West Belleville, where about 400 people watched and the sporting crowd made a lion of him.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday, April 9, 1883, page 8.

facts.fact: Allen went to West Belleville, Illinois, to watch a quoits match between Dr. Truman of St. Louis and G. Knowles at Sam Swancut's

notes: Match was 'yesterday' relative to the Monday April 9 paper, so Sunday April 8.
